domain_setting: A contemporary workplace with offices, workstations, a shared break room, calendars, payroll papers and people collaborating. Keep employment arrangements, compensation, time off and job changes visually distinct.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 card with key people/objects x24..280, y16..176
No readable text, numbers, company logos, pay amounts, signs
Use simple schedule, document and currency symbols without words or numerals
Respectful varied depictions of workers, including parents on leave

polysemy_resolution_table.company: Business organization and its office/team, not visitors or companionship. Although the supplied Japanese gloss lists visitors/guests, the work-organization group and adjacent headquarters/staff/employee terms select the employer-business sense.
polysemy_resolution_table.staff: Employees/workforce, not a rod. The supplied Japanese gloss lists the staff-as-stick sense, but the group context selects the workplace collective noun.
polysemy_resolution_table.break: A scheduled rest pause during work, not damage. The supplied Japanese gloss lists the verb meaning to break an object, but the time-off group selects the rest-pause sense.
polysemy_resolution_table.raise: A pay increase in this compensation context, not lifting an object.
polysemy_resolution_table.schedule: A work timetable, not a transit timetable. The supplied Japanese gloss lists a transport timetable, but the work-arrangements group selects a work schedule.
polysemy_resolution_table.be laid off: Lose a job through workforce reduction, not individual misconduct dismissal.
polysemy_resolution_table.laid off: A worker's state of losing a job through workforce reduction.
polysemy_resolution_table.made redundant: A role removed in restructuring, not personal blame.
polysemy_resolution_table.get fired: Dismissal for individual performance/conduct, distinct from a layoff.
polysemy_resolution_table.permanent: Ongoing job without a planned end date.
polysemy_resolution_table.temporary: A job with a limited end date.
polysemy_resolution_table.remote work: Working away from the employer's workplace, such as at home.
polysemy_resolution_table.nine-to-five job: A conventional daytime regular office schedule. Never include numerals in the illustration.

contrast_notes.apprentice / intern / assistant / employ: Differentiate through a trade mentor and hands-on training, short placement with mentor, support role, hired worker, hiring owner, coordinator, collective workforce, business office/team, customer consulting a professional, peer sharing a workstation, professional peer exchange, and central office building.
contrast_notes.employment / permanent / temporary / par: Show a signed work agreement, an unbounded work calendar, a calendar ending at a marked date without digits, a shorter weekly schedule, a home workstation, and a regular daytime office schedule.
contrast_notes.hours / overtime / schedule: Show a bounded shift span, work continuing after the shift, and an organized rota/calendar.
contrast_notes.salary / wages / hourly rate / earn / pa: Separate fixed regular pay packet, accumulated wage coins, pay-per-hour clock, income from completing work, employer-to-worker payment, extra reward, increased pay, and reduced pay.
contrast_notes.benefits / health insurance: Use a package of workplace supports and a medical coverage card/shield.
contrast_notes.annual vacation / vacation / day off / h: Distinguish leave allocation, travel/rest leisure, free day, action of taking a free day, paid-leave balance, short pause mid-shift, illness recovery time, notifying work while ill, parental-leave period, and the action of starting that leave.
contrast_notes.be laid off / laid off / made redundant: Show a company-wide workforce reduction, a worker leaving after the reduction, a role removed in restructuring, and a distinct individual dismissal meeting.
contrast_notes.promotion / retire / retirement: Show advancement in role, the action of leaving work at career end, and settled retirement life.
